title: SB979 (2024 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2024/bills/SB979_.HTM; sha256 b1b41d2ae3ac1a1781a758e322da9e4ffbea1ba99c41d9013aff18dfdad6903c)
provenance.note: As filed. Adds a new section to HRS chapter 134. No passage vote on file; later amendments are not in the text read.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (new): (a) No person shall be granted a license to carry under section 134-9 unless the person, at any time prior to the granting of the license, has completed a firearms skills assessment, safety course, and education course. (b) The requirements under this section shall be in addition to the education and safety or training course prerequisites for a permit to acquire under section 134-2(g).
